from solution import Service, GatewayTimeout


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.calls = 0
        self.fail_next = 0       # raise timeout (after charging) this many times
        self.fail_before = 0     # raise timeout without charging

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.fail_before > 0:
            self.fail_before -= 1
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        if self.fail_next > 0:
            self.fail_next -= 1
            raise GatewayTimeout()


def make(ttl=3600):
    clock, gw = Clock(), Gateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    assert svc.register("alice", "password1")[0] == 201
    token = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    return svc, clock, gw, token


def second_user(svc, name="bobby"):
    assert svc.register(name, "password1")[0] == 201
    return svc.login(name, "password1")[1]["token"]


def test_register_validation():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("ab", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("A" * 5, "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("a" * 33, "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("a" * 32, "password1")[0] == 201
    assert svc.register("bad-name", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("abc\n", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("okname", "short")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("alice", "password1")[0] == 409


def test_login():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.login("alice", "nope")[0] == 401
    assert svc.login("ghost", "password1")[0] == 401
    t1 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert t1 != t2


def test_token_expiry_boundary():
    svc, clock, _, token = make(ttl=100)
    clock.t = 1099.9
    assert svc.export_documents(token)[0] == 200
    clock.t = 1100.0
    assert svc.export_documents(token)[0] == 401


def test_logout():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    other = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert svc.logout(token)[0] == 204
    assert svc.logout(token)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(token)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(other)[0] == 200
    assert svc.logout(None)[0] == 401


def test_document_validation():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    assert svc.create_document(token, "", "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(token, "t" * 201, "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(token, "t" * 200, "x" * 100000)[0] == 201
    assert svc.create_document(token, "t", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document("bad", "t", "x")[0] == 401
    doc_id = svc.create_document(token, "t", "c")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.update_document(token, doc_id, "", "c")[0] == 400
    assert svc.update_document(token, doc_id, "t", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400


def test_ids_unique_after_delete():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    a = svc.create_document(token, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(token, a)
    b = svc.create_document(token, "b", "")[1]["id"]
    assert a != b


def test_ownership():
    svc, _, _, ta = make()
    tb = second_user(svc)
    doc_id = svc.create_document(ta, "secret", "stuff")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.get_document(tb, doc_id)[0] == 404
    assert svc.update_document(tb, doc_id, "x", "y")[0] == 404
    assert svc.delete_document(tb, doc_id)[0] == 404
    assert svc.get_document(tb, "missing")[0] == 404
    assert svc.list_documents(tb)[1]["items"] == []
    assert svc.search_documents(tb, "secret")[1] == []
    assert svc.export_documents(tb)[1] == []
    assert svc.get_document(ta, doc_id)[0] == 200


def test_deleted_never_returned():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    a = svc.create_document(token, "alpha", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.create_document(token, "beta", "")
    svc.delete_document(token, a)
    assert svc.delete_document(token, a)[0] == 404
    assert svc.update_document(token, a, "x", "y")[0] == 404
    assert [d["title"] for d in svc.export_documents(token)[1]] == ["beta"]
    assert svc.search_documents(token, "alpha")[1] == []
    assert [d["title"] for d in svc.list_documents(token)[1]["items"]] == ["beta"]


def test_pagination_full_walk():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    ids = [svc.create_document(token, "t%d" % i, "")[1]["id"] for i in range(7)]
    seen, cursor = [], None
    while True:
        status, page = svc.list_documents(token, 3, cursor)
        assert status == 200
        seen += [d["id"] for d in page["items"]]
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break
    assert seen == ids


def test_pagination_mutations():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    ids = [svc.create_document(token, "t%d" % i, "")[1]["id"] for i in range(5)]
    status, p1 = svc.list_documents(token, 2)
    assert [d["id"] for d in p1["items"]] == ids[:2]
    svc.delete_document(token, ids[2])
    svc.delete_document(token, ids[0])  # already returned, deleted
    new = svc.create_document(token, "new", "")[1]["id"]
    status, p2 = svc.list_documents(token, 2, p1["next_cursor"])
    assert [d["id"] for d in p2["items"]] == [ids[3], ids[4]]
    status, p3 = svc.list_documents(token, 2, p2["next_cursor"])
    assert [d["id"] for d in p3["items"]] == [new]
    assert p3["next_cursor"] is None


def test_pagination_cursor_after_deleting_boundary_doc():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    ids = [svc.create_document(token, "t%d" % i, "")[1]["id"] for i in range(4)]
    p1 = svc.list_documents(token, 2)[1]
    svc.delete_document(token, ids[1])  # last item of page 1
    p2 = svc.list_documents(token, 2, p1["next_cursor"])[1]
    assert [d["id"] for d in p2["items"]] == ids[2:]


def test_pagination_errors():
    svc, _, _, ta = make()
    tb = second_user(svc)
    for i in range(3):
        svc.create_document(ta, "t", "")
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 0)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 101)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 100)[0] == 200
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, 2, "bogus")[0] == 400
    cur = svc.list_documents(ta, 2)[1]["next_cursor"]
    assert svc.list_documents(tb, 2, cur)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents("bad")[0] == 401


def test_search_case_insensitive_content_and_title():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    svc.create_document(token, "Hello", "world")
    svc.create_document(token, "other", "HELLO there")
    svc.create_document(token, "none", "none")
    assert [d["title"] for d in svc.search_documents(token, "hElLo")[1]] == ["Hello", "other"]
    assert svc.search_documents(token, "")[0] == 400


def test_update_keeps_order():
    svc, _, _, token = make()
    a = svc.create_document(token, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    b = svc.create_document(token, "b", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.update_document(token, a, "a2", "new")
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.export_documents(token)[1]] == [a, b]
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.list_documents(token)[1]["items"]] == [a, b]


def test_created_at():
    svc, clock, _, token = make()
    clock.t = 5.5
    d = svc.create_document(token, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    clock.t = 9.0
    assert svc.get_document(token, d)[1]["created_at"] == 5.5
    svc.update_document(token, d, "b", "")
    assert svc.get_document(token, d)[1]["created_at"] == 5.5


def test_pay_validation():
    svc, _, gw, token = make()
    assert svc.pay(token, 0, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(token, 1000001, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(token, 1.5, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(token, True, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(token, "5", "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay("bad", 5, "k")[0] == 401
    assert svc.pay(token, 1000000, "k")[0] == 201
    assert svc.pay(token, 1, "k2")[0] == 201


def test_idempotent_retry():
    svc, _, gw, token = make()
    s1, p1 = svc.pay(token, 500, "k")
    s2, p2 = svc.pay(token, 500, "k")
    assert (s1, s2) == (201, 200) and p1 == p2
    assert svc.pay(token, 600, "k")[0] == 409
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1
    assert len(svc.list_payments(token)[1]) == 1


def test_idempotency_scoped_to_user():
    svc, _, gw, ta = make()
    tb = second_user(svc)
    assert svc.pay(ta, 500, "k")[0] == 201
    assert svc.pay(tb, 700, "k")[0] == 201
    assert len(gw.charges) == 2
    assert [p["amount_cents"] for p in svc.list_payments(tb)[1]] == [700]


def test_timeout_then_retry_after_charge():
    svc, _, gw, token = make()
    gw.fail_next = 1  # charge goes through, but answer is lost
    assert svc.pay(token, 500, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.list_payments(token)[1] == []
    status, p = svc.pay(token, 500, "k")
    assert status in (200, 201)
    assert len(svc.list_payments(token)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1
    assert svc.pay(token, 500, "k")[0] == 200
    assert len(svc.list_payments(token)[1]) == 1


def test_timeout_then_different_amount_conflicts():
    svc, _, gw, token = make()
    gw.fail_next = 1
    assert svc.pay(token, 500, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.pay(token, 600, "k")[0] == 409
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1


def test_timeout_without_charge_then_retry():
    svc, _, gw, token = make()
    gw.fail_before = 2
    assert svc.pay(token, 500, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.pay(token, 500, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.pay(token, 500, "k")[0] in (200, 201)
    assert len(svc.list_payments(token)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1


def test_payment_order_and_created_at():
    svc, clock, _, token = make()
    clock.t = 42.0
    svc.pay(token, 1, "a")
    svc.pay(token, 2, "b")
    pays = svc.list_payments(token)[1]
    assert [p["idempotency_key"] for p in pays] == ["a", "b"]
    assert pays[0]["created_at"] == 42.0

import string

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- fakes

class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, d):
        self.t += d


class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; behaviour per call can be scripted."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}   # reference -> amount
        self.calls = []
        self.script = []    # items: "ok" | "timeout_before" | "timeout_after"

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        mode = self.script.pop(0) if self.script else "ok"
        if mode == "timeout_before":
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout")
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if mode == "timeout_after":
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout")
        return {"id": "tx-%s" % (reference,), "reference": reference,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents}


DOC_KEYS = {"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}
PAY_KEYS = {"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}
NAME_CHARS = string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits + "_"
TEXT = st.text(alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_categories=("Cs",)), max_size=40)
TITLE = st.text(alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_categories=("Cs",)),
                min_size=1, max_size=200)


def make(ttl=None):
    clock, gw = FakeClock(), FakeGateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw) if ttl is None else Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw


def user(svc, name="alice", pw="password1"):
    out = svc.register(name, pw)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input={(name, pw)!r} output={out!r}"
    out = svc.login(name, pw)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input={(name, pw)!r} output={out!r}"
    return out[1]["token"]


def mk(svc, tok, title="t", content="c"):
    out = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input={(title, content)!r} output={out!r}"
    return out[1]["id"]


def collect(svc, tok, page_size):
    ids, cursor, pages = [], None, 0
    while True:
        out = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=page_size, cursor=cursor)
        assert out[0] == 200, f"input={(page_size, cursor)!r} output={out!r}"
        ids.extend(d["id"] for d in out[1]["items"])
        cursor = out[1]["next_cursor"]
        pages += 1
        assert pages < 2000, f"input={(page_size,)!r} output=endless pagination"
        if cursor is None:
            return ids


def ids_of(docs):
    return [d["id"] for d in docs]


# ------------------------------------------------------- REQ-14 register

def test_register_username_length_boundaries():
    """A username of 3 to 32 characters is accepted and 2 or 33 characters give 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    for name, exp in [("ab", 400), ("abc", 201), ("a" * 32, 201), ("a" * 33, 400), ("", 400)]:
        out = svc.register(name, "password1")
        assert out[0] == exp, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


def test_register_username_charset():
    """A username must consist only of characters from [a-z0-9_]."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    for name in ["Alice", "ali ce", "ali-ce", "ali.ce", "ali!"]:
        out = svc.register(name, "password1")
        assert out[0] == 400, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"
    for name in ["a_b", "123", "___", "user_01"]:
        out = svc.register(name, "password1")
        assert out[0] == 201, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


def test_register_password_length_boundary():
    """A password of at least 8 characters is accepted and 7 characters give 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register("bob", "1234567")
    assert out[0] == 400, f"input=('bob','1234567') output={out!r}"
    out = svc.register("bob", "12345678")
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input=('bob','12345678') output={out!r}"


def test_register_duplicate_is_409():
    """Registering an existing username gives 409."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("carol", "password1")[0] == 201
    out = svc.register("carol", "otherpass1")
    assert out[0] == 409, f"input=('carol',) output={out!r}"


@given(name=st.text(alphabet=NAME_CHARS, min_size=3, max_size=32),
       pw=st.text(alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_categories=("Cs",)), min_size=8, max_size=40))
@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)

    assert out[0] == 201, f"input={(name, pw)!r} output={out!r}"
    out = svc.login(name, pw)

@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)

# ------------------------------------------------------------ REQ-14 login

def test_login_failures_are_401():
    """Login with a wrong password or an unknown user gives 401."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    svc.register("dave", "password1")
    for args in [("dave", "wrongpass1"), ("nobody", "password1")]:
        out = svc.login(*args)
        assert out[0] == 401, f"input={args!r} output={out!r}"


def test_login_returns_new_token_each_time():
    """Each successful login returns a new token."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    svc.register("erin", "password1")
    t1 = svc.login("erin", "password1")
    t2 = svc.login("erin", "password1")
    assert t1[0] == 200 and t2[0] == 200, f"output={t1!r} {t2!r}"
    assert t1[1]["token"] != t2[1]["token"], f"output={t1!r} {t2!r}"


# --------------------------------------------------------- token validity

def test_token_expiry_boundary_default_ttl():
    """A token is accepted while now < created + 3600 and rejected from that instant on."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    clock.advance(3599.5)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=t+3599.5 output={out!r}"
    clock.advance(0.5)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input=t+3600 output={out!r}"


def test_token_expiry_counts_from_login_time():
    """A token's lifetime starts at its creation by login, not at registration."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=60)
    svc.register("frank", "password1")
    clock.advance(500)
    tok = svc.login("frank", "password1")[1]["token"]
    clock.advance(59.5)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=login+59.5 output={out!r}"
    clock.advance(0.5)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input=login+60 output={out!r}"
    tok2 = svc.login("frank", "password1")[1]["token"]
    out = svc.list_documents(tok2)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=new login output={out!r}"


@given(ttl=st.integers(1, 5000), data=st.data())
@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
def test_token_valid_iff_now_before_created_plus_ttl(ttl, data):
    """A token is accepted exactly while clock.now() < created + token_ttl."""
    d2 = data.draw(st.integers(0, 4 * ttl))
    delta = d2 / 2.0
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=ttl)
    tok = user(svc)
    clock.advance(delta)
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    exp = 200 if delta < ttl else 401
    assert out[0] == exp, f"input=(ttl={ttl}, delta={delta}) output={out!r}"


def all_calls(svc, doc_id):
    return {
        "logout": lambda t: svc.logout(t),
        "create": lambda t: svc.create_document(t, "x", "y"),
        "get": lambda t: svc.get_document(t, doc_id),
        "update": lambda t: svc.update_document(t, doc_id, "x", "y"),
        "delete": lambda t: svc.delete_document(t, doc_id),
        "list": lambda t: svc.list_documents(t),
        "search": lambda t: svc.search_documents(t, "x"),
        "export": lambda t: svc.export_documents(t),
        "pay": lambda t: svc.pay(t, 100, "key-1"),
        "list_payments": lambda t: svc.list_payments(t),
    }


def test_missing_and_unknown_token_is_401_everywhere():
    """Every method returns 401 for a missing or unknown token."""
    svc, _, gw = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    did = mk(svc, tok)
    for bad in [None, "bogus-token", ""]:
        for name, call in all_calls(svc, did).items():
            out = call(bad)
            assert out[0] == 401, f"input={name}({bad!r}) output={out!r}"
    assert gw.charged == {}, f"input=pay with bad token output=charged {gw.charged!r}"
    assert svc.get_document(tok, did)[0] == 200


def test_expired_token_is_401_everywhere():
    """Every method returns 401 for an expired token."""
    svc, clock, gw = make(ttl=100)
    tok = user(svc)
    did = mk(svc, tok)
    clock.advance(100)
    for name, call in all_calls(svc, did).items():
        out = call(tok)
        assert out[0] == 401, f"input={name}(expired) output={out!r}"
    assert gw.charged == {}, f"input=pay expired output=charged {gw.charged!r}"


# ----------------------------------------------------------- REQ-15 logout

def test_logout_revokes_token_for_every_method():
    """A revoked token is rejected by every method, including logout itself."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    did = mk(svc, tok)
    out = svc.logout(tok)
    assert out[0] == 204, f"input=logout output={out!r}"
    for name, call in all_calls(svc, did).items():
        out = call(tok)
        assert out[0] == 401, f"input={name}(revoked) output={out!r}"


def test_logout_keeps_other_tokens_of_same_user_valid():
    """Logging out one token leaves other tokens of the same user valid."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    t1 = user(svc, "gina", "password1")
    t2 = svc.login("gina", "password1")[1]["token"]
    did = mk(svc, t1)
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 204
    out = svc.get_document(t2, did)
    assert out[0] == 200 and out[1]["id"] == did, f"input=get with other token output={out!r}"


def test_logout_unknown_token_is_401():
    """Logout with an unknown token returns 401."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.logout("nope")
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input='nope' output={out!r}"


# ------------------------------------------------------ REQ-16 create/get

def test_create_returns_id_and_get_returns_full_document():
    """A created document is returned by get with id, title, content and created_at."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)

@given(data=st.data(), n=st.integers(0, 12), page_size=st.integers(1, 5))
@settings(max_examples=80, deadline=None)
def test_pagination_matches_model_under_concurrent_changes(data, n, page_size):
    """Pagination returns no duplicates and skips no remaining document despite deletes and creates between pages."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    order = [mk(svc, tok, f"t{i}") for i in range(n)]
    alive = set(order)
    last = -1
    returned = []
    cursor = None
    for _ in range(100):
        out = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=page_size, cursor=cursor)
        assert out[0] == 200, f"input={(page_size, cursor)!r} output={out!r}"
        cand = [d for i, d in enumerate(order) if i > last and d in alive]
        got = ids_of(out[1]["items"])
        assert got == cand[:page_size], \
            f"input={(n, page_size, cursor)!r} expected={cand[:page_size]!r} output={got!r}"
        if len(cand) < page_size:
            assert out[1]["next_cursor"] is None, f"input={(n, page_size)!r} output={out!r}"
        if len(cand) > page_size:
            assert out[1]["next_cursor"] is not None, f"input={(n, page_size)!r} output={out!r}"
        returned.extend(got)
        if got:
            last = order.index(got[-1])
        cursor = out[1]["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break
        dels = data.draw(st.lists(st.integers(0, 1000), max_size=3))
        for k in dels:
            live = [d for d in order if d in alive]
            if live:
                victim = live[k % len(live)]
                assert svc.delete_document(tok, victim)[0] == 204
                alive.discard(victim)
        for _c in range(data.draw(st.integers(0, 3))):
            d = mk(svc, tok, f"n{len(order)}")
            order.append(d)
            alive.add(d)
    else:
        pytest.fail(f"input={(n, page_size)!r} output=pagination did not terminate")
    assert len(returned) == len(set(returned)), f"input={(n, page_size)!r} output={returned!r}"

from gateway import GatewayTimeout


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += dt


class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; can time out (before or after charging)."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = []
        self.fail_next = 0
        self.after = False

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.fail_next > 0:
            self.fail_next -= 1
            if self.after:
                self.charged.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charged.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        return "ok"


def make(ttl=None):
    clock = Clock()
    gw = FakeGateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw) if ttl is None else Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- fakes

class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class FakeGateway:
    """Idempotent by reference. mode: None | 'before' | 'after' (timeout)."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = []
        self.mode = None

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}


def make(ttl=3600):
    clock = FakeClock()
    gw = FakeGateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw

    items = []
    cursor = None
    for _ in range(500):
        s, body = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=k, cursor=cursor)
        assert s == 200, f"input={(k, cursor)!r} output={(s, body)!r}"

@given(st.integers(0, 8), st.integers(1, 4),
       st.lists(st.tuples(st.sampled_from(["create", "delete"]), st.integers(0, 50)), max_size=12))
@settings(deadline=None)
def test_property_pagination_under_concurrent_changes(n, k, ops):
    """While following cursors, deleted documents are not returned, none repeats, none surviving is skipped, order is creation order."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    created = [mk(svc, tok, f"t{i}", "c") for i in range(n)]
    alive = list(created)
    order = {i: idx for idx, i in enumerate(created)}
    returned = []
    cursor = None
    op_iter = iter(ops)
    for _ in range(200):
        snapshot = set(alive)
        s, body = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=k, cursor=cursor)
        assert s == 200, f"input={(n, k, ops, cursor)!r} output={(s, body)!r}"
        got = ids(body["items"])
        for i in got:
            assert i in snapshot, f"input={(n, k, ops)!r} output=returned dead or unknown doc {i!r}"
            assert i not in returned, f"input={(n, k, ops)!r} output=duplicate {i!r}"
            returned.append(i)
        idxs = [order[i] for i in returned]
        assert idxs == sorted(idxs), f"input={(n, k, ops)!r} output=order {returned!r}"
        cursor = body["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            missing = snapshot - set(returned)
            assert not missing, f"input={(n, k, ops)!r} output=skipped {missing!r}"
            break
        op = next(op_iter, None)
        if op is None:
            continue
        kind, idx = op
        if kind == "create":
            new = mk(svc, tok, "late", "c")
            order[new] = len(order)
            created.append(new)
            alive.append(new)
        elif alive:
            victim = alive.pop(idx % len(alive))
            assert svc.delete_document(tok, victim)[0] == 204
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"input={(n, k, ops)!r} output=pagination did not terminate")

def test_property_payment_sequences_match_idempotency_model(ops, amounts):
    """For any retry sequence with timeouts, each (user, key) yields at most one payment and one charge, replays return the original, conflicts give 409."""
    svc, clock, gw = make()

    recorded = {}     # (u, k) -> payment
    order = {"a": [], "b": []}
    attempted = set()
    for u, key, mode, conflict in ops:
        clock.t += 1
        gw.mode = mode
        amount = amounts[key]
        pair = (u, key)
        if conflict and pair in recorded:
            out = svc.pay(toks[u], amount % 1000000 + 1, key)
            assert out[0] == 409, f"input={(u, key, amount + 1)!r} output={out!r}"
            continue
        attempted.add(pair)

        elif mode is None:
            assert s == 201 and p["amount_cents"] == amount and p["idempotency_key"] == key, \
                f"input={(u, key, mode)!r} output={(s, p)!r}"
            recorded[pair] = p
            order[u].append(p)
        else:
            assert s == 504, f"input={(u, key, mode)!r} output={(s, p)!r}"
        for who in ("a", "b"):
            assert svc.list_payments(toks[who]) == (200, order[who]), \
                f"input={(u, key, mode)!r} output={svc.list_payments(toks[who])!r}"
        assert len(gw.charged) <= len(attempted), f"input={ops!r} output={gw.charged!r}"
    gw.mode = None
    for (u, key) in sorted(attempted):
        s, p = svc.pay(toks[u], amounts[key], key)
        assert s in (200, 201) and p["amount_cents"] == amounts[key], f"input={(u, key)!r} output={(s, p)!r}"
        if (u, key) in recorded:
